concept: Escanor adapted as a day-powered axe fighter whose automatic attacks intensify through Sunshine. All mechanics and purchases are Tower Defense proposals, not claims of canon execution.

signature.name: Sunshine
signature.adaptation: Escanor's power and size rise during the day and peak at noon; the unit represents this through purchases that strengthen his attacks. The game plan does not simulate time of day or physical transformation.

repertoire.name: Super Slash
repertoire.limitation: Escanor makes a powerful downward axe slash; the cited account gives no exact target count or attack cadence.

effects.effect: The downward axe slash deals considerable damage.
effects.reason: The base attack represents the powerful slash as a single-target hit; purchases can strengthen it.

effects.effect: The attack's force can be felt several meters away.
effects.reason: Later range purchases are a qualitative reach adaptation, not a claim about measured canon distance.

repertoire.name: Cruel Sun
repertoire.limitation: Escanor creates a miniature sun, controls and enlarges it, and strikes opponents with it; the passages do not specify a projectile count or exact blast radius.

effects.effect: The miniature sun radiates heat that melts nearby armor.
effects.reason: A bounded burn status adapts the heat against an eligible hit target.

effects.effect: Escanor controls the miniature sun and strikes opponents with it, enlarging it.
effects.reason: The path adapts the strike as a heavier hit that can affect nearby enemies; no separate controllable projectile is claimed.

repertoire.name: The One
repertoire.limitation: The One is Escanor's noon peak and lasts one minute; the source does not describe a player-triggered ability or game cooldown.

effects.effect: At noon Escanor reaches his peak for one minute.
effects.reason: The middle path's temporary boost adapts the brief peak; its game trigger and cooldown are proposed and do not reproduce noon.

effects.effect: In this form his strength is great enough to knock away a powerful opponent with one hand strike.
effects.reason: The boost increases the damage of his existing attack; it does not claim invincibility or a guaranteed defeat.

repertoire.name: Crazy Prominence
repertoire.limitation: Escanor produces many miniature suns that explode on impact; the passages do not give their exact count or blast size.

effects.effect: Escanor produces many miniature suns from his body.
effects.reason: The bottom path's fifth purchase adapts the miniature suns as a volley, but no milestone whose technique is Crazy Prominence promises projectiles, so this effect is not represented in the plan.

effects.effect: The miniature suns explode on impact.
effects.reason: The bottom path's fifth purchase describes impact splash, but no milestone whose technique is Crazy Prominence promises splash, so this effect is not represented in the plan.

base.name: Super Slash
base.behavior: At 0-0-0 Escanor makes a single downward Rhitta slash at the player's selected target. It is a normal-damage, single-projectile attack with qualitative single-target capacity and no claimed area effect. The axe's weight and Escanor's daytime strength inform the attack's presentation, not an extra mechanic.

path1.name: Cruel Sun
path1.buyFor: Choose this path for heat that persists on hit and later affects nearby enemies, while keeping Escanor's selected-target axe attack.
path1.weakness: The heat effects apply only through his attacks and their defined hit capacities; the path does not create independently moving suns, ignore obstructions, or control enemy movement.

milestones.tier1: 1-x-x makes each selected-target Rhitta slash hit harder as Escanor channels Sunshine into the strike; it remains one normal-damage attack.
milestones.tier2: 2-x-x further strengthens the single-target slash with Cruel Sun's heat; it adds no status or separate projectile.
milestones.tier3: 3-x-x adds a burn to enemies damaged by the selected-target slash, representing Cruel Sun's heat; each new hit refreshes the defined burn rather than stacking it.
milestones.tier4: 4-x-x increases the slash's damage and reach while retaining its burn on enemies it damages; it remains a single-target attack.
milestones.tier5: 5-x-x makes the selected-target Cruel Sun strike damage enemies near its primary target with splash, while its burn applies only to enemies the attack damages; its increased reach does not enlarge the splash area.

path1.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase adds splash to the Cruel Sun hit, giving this single placement a way to affect a group rather than merely buying another fourth-tier copy.

crosspaths.contribution: Proposed early purchases: x-1-x makes Escanor's ordinary Rhitta slash arrive more frequently as he approaches The One; the selected target and single-hit delivery remain unchanged. x-2-x makes the ordinary slash arrive even more frequently as Escanor approaches his peak, without changing its damage or target choice.

Proposed early purchases: x-x-1 increases the number of enemies a single Rhitta slash can hit along its clear attack path; it remains one projectile aimed at the selected target. x-x-2 further increases the slash's hit capacity while keeping its single-projectile delivery and selected target.

path1.referenceExample: The Profile's scale references inform this proposal; the supplied Definition alone authorizes mechanics.

path2.name: The One
path2.buyFor: Choose this path for a permanent increase in striking speed that culminates in a temporary, manually triggered The One attack boost.
path2.weakness: The boost affects only Escanor's own attack and has a cooldown; it is not a second attack, grants no invulnerability, and does not reproduce the source's noon condition or one-minute duration.

milestones.tier1: x-1-x makes Escanor's ordinary Rhitta slash arrive more frequently as he approaches The One; the selected target and single-hit delivery remain unchanged.
milestones.tier2: x-2-x makes the ordinary slash arrive even more frequently as Escanor approaches his peak, without changing its damage or target choice.
milestones.tier3: x-3-x further strengthens and quickens the ordinary slash, developing the path's rising-power identity without adding a new attack form.
milestones.tier4: x-4-x unlocks one manually activated temporary boost to Escanor's existing attack, increasing its damage and rate for the boost window; the ordinary attack retains all permanent purchases, and the ability begins its cooldown when activated.
milestones.tier5: x-5-x extends and strengthens the same manual boost and adds a bounded follow-up from each boosted primary hit to distinct eligible secondary enemies; it does not strike the primary again or create a second Active Ability.

path2.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase makes the single boosted attack reach additional distinct targets, so concentrating on this path grants group access unavailable from another fourth-tier copy.

Proposed early purchases: x-x-1 increases the number of enemies a single Rhitta slash can hit along its clear attack path; it remains one projectile aimed at the selected target. x-x-2 further increases the slash's hit capacity while keeping its single-projectile delivery and selected target.

path2.referenceExample: The Profile's scale references inform this proposal; the supplied Definition alone authorizes mechanics.

path3.name: Crazy Prominence
path3.buyFor: Choose this path to turn selected-target attacks into a volley whose separate impacts can reach nearby enemies.
path3.weakness: The volley concentrates on the player's selected primary target and has bounded projectile and splash capacity; it does not grant independent target selection or an unbounded chain.

milestones.tier1: x-x-1 increases the number of enemies a single Rhitta slash can hit along its clear attack path; it remains one projectile aimed at the selected target.
milestones.tier2: x-x-2 further increases the slash's hit capacity while keeping its single-projectile delivery and selected target.
milestones.tier3: x-x-3 strengthens the slash and establishes the path's impact-focused development; it still makes one attack against the selected target.
milestones.tier4: x-x-4 further strengthens the slash and its hit capacity along the clear attack path; it adds no volley before the fifth purchase.
milestones.tier5: x-x-5 replaces the single projectile with a volley of multiple projectiles aimed at the player's selected primary target; each projectile has its own hit capacity and impact splash, and enemies may be hit by separate projectiles.

path3.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase adds Crazy Prominence's defining multi-sun volley and impact pattern to this placement, rather than offering only a larger single slash.

omittedTechniques.name: Sunshine
omittedTechniques.reason: Sunshine's central time-dependent behavior is Escanor's power steadily rising from dawn to its noon peak, then declining as the sun sets; at night he is powerless and unable to use magic. The Definition cannot express a time-of-day cycle or make an attack's power follow that external schedule. The purchases adapt selected stronger attacks, but neither a typed stat change nor a proposed mechanic on those purchases carries the essential daylight-triggered progression and reversal; adding a proposal would not make that unsupported global time condition playable.

omittedTechniques.name: Pride Flare
omittedTechniques.reason: The cited description is Cruel Sun flaring with heat intense enough to vaporize a lake instantly. The Definition has no instant lake-scale environmental destruction; burn and splash do not express that scale, and a proposed mechanic would not make that unsupported environmental behavior playable.

omittedTechniques.name: Final Prominence
omittedTechniques.reason: The cited Ultimate-only technique concentrates Escanor's power into a gigantic swirling fireball and hurls it. This plan does not implement The One: Ultimate or its distinct concentrated fireball delivery; the Definition cannot represent that named delivery as a separate attack, and the ordinary volley is not that technique.

omittedTechniques.name: Rhitta
omittedTechniques.reason: The source describes Rhitta absorbing and storing Escanor's daytime heat, releasing it on command with precision, and allowing a daytime form at night if sufficiently charged. This plan uses the axe as the base weapon but does not implement heat storage, command release, or nighttime access; the Definition has no charge-storage or off-schedule form mechanic.

omittedTechniques.name: Daytime
omittedTechniques.reason: Daytime describes Escanor's gradual bodily and mental transformation and intense heat radiating around him. The purchases adapt selected attack effects, but the Definition cannot express the full time-driven bodily and personality transformation or a persistent personal heat aura.

omittedTechniques.name: Night-time
omittedTechniques.reason: Night-time describes Escanor's return to a frail state and inability to use magic. The unit has no time-of-day state or attack-disable schedule, which the Definition cannot express.

omittedTechniques.name: Divine Sword Escanor
omittedTechniques.reason: The cited technique is a downward hand swipe that cuts an opponent and destroys an attraction-force technique. The slash's attack effect is expressible in broad terms, but this unit selects the axe slash instead; the special interaction that destroys another technique has no corresponding enemy mechanic or typed effect in the Definition.

omittedTechniques.name: Divine Spear Escanor
omittedTechniques.reason: The cited technique is a finger thrust with enough force to pierce an opponent. This plan does not add a distinct finger-thrust delivery, and the Definition has no separate piercing-through behavior beyond ordinary hit capacity.

omittedTechniques.name: Large Spear
omittedTechniques.reason: The evidence only establishes that Escanor briefly possessed a large spear and that it was lighter than Rhitta; it does not describe an attack to adapt.

omittedTechniques.name: Magic Glasses
omittedTechniques.reason: The glasses suppress Escanor's daytime form and their removal triggers his larger self. The Definition has no equipment toggle or transformation trigger, so this conditional form control cannot be represented.

scopeLimits: The supplied selection is bounded and does not establish complete source coverage; the repertoire is limited to selected documented attacks and forms.

No story period is specified. Sunshine's ownership changed between Escanor and Mael, and the evidence says Escanor returned it to Mael, later received it back, and retained it until death. The unit uses an explicitly historical Escanor subset and does not claim present availability after his death or later revival.

The Definition does not model time of day, the noon prerequisite, the one-minute canon duration, physical transformation, personality changes, bodily damage from Sunshine, durability, or resurrection.
All proposed purchase behavior is a game adaptation, not evidence that canon attacks have these exact hit counts, statuses, capacities, ranges, cooldowns, or targeting rules.
